description: Review finding CON-8: The JMAP `Envelope` exposes `seqNo` (which is inside the ciphertext) and does not match `RoutingEnvelope` (lens CON). Location: spec/11-transport.md:336, :349; spec/05-messaging.md:226; spec/10-relays.md:561 (SHOULD-level second history API); spec/11-transport.md:279 vs :341-350, :404. Fix: As the reviewer proposes. Drop `seqNo`. Store the exact encoded `RoutingEnvelope` bytes plus `receivedAt` and the CID. Delete 10:561 or make it an alias. Either define `Envelope/set` with the access proof or delete the write clause at 11:279. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
